question: What is the name of the highest peak of the Eastern Ghats?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahendragiri**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mahendragiri** is the highest peak of the Eastern Ghats.
 
• It is located in the state of **Odisha**.
 
• The peak rises to an elevation of **1,501 meters (4,925 feet)** above sea level.
 
• Mahendragiri is a part of the **Mahendragiri Hill Range**.
